title: Draw each observed rim with its bowl walls
alt_text: Lower and higher views show shallow bowls with gently curved sides narrowing to the base. Each rim has separate width and height marks; the higher opening is more open and slightly narrower.
caption: Measure each ellipse in its own view before comparing how open it looks.

review_notes: Both vessels have shallow curved bowl walls, not straight cup sides. The higher-view ellipse opens more while its apparent width is slightly narrower; each rim has separate measurement marks.
